text:
anya: Quick sync - proposal for a compact archival + rehydration flow to cut long-tail trace storage costs. Patchwork of ideas below.

rachel: high-level?

anya: Keep full spans for 14d, compact per-request shards for 60d, metrics-only for 365d. Add a bloom-backed existence check to avoid unnecessary cold reads.

zhen: Bloom filters make sense for existence checks, but watch false-positives -> extra rehydrates. Target FPR 0.1% per-tenant-day.

oliver: How do we prevent privacy/existence leak? BF presence could reveal traffic patterns.

anya: BF service will be internal only, ACL protected. We salt tenant ids and rotate monthly. No raw bitmaps exposed.

rachel: Compact shard format? What fields?

zhen: Minimal proto: request_hash, start_ts, duration_ms, error_flags, top_ops[], top_spans_summary, tenant_id, billing_key. Full spans removed. Use delta-encoding + zstd.

oliver: UX for developers: find-span -> BF check -> if BF says maybe, enqueue rehydrate and show "rehydrating" modal with ETA, else show compact summary.

rachel: ETA? rehydrate times vary a lot. Need priority path for incidents.

anya: Default rehydrate ETA 10-30m median, p95 ~2h. Incident-priority queue reduces median to 2-10m.

zhen: Cost model: bloom index ~0.1 bits/trace for 0.1% FPR per day-per-tenant-ish. Breadcrumb index for 180d is ~32 bytes/trace. We estimated cold storage drop ~30-45% depending on sampling.

oliver: Chargeback for rehydrates? Must be explicit or ops will eat cost.

anya: Proposal: tenant pays small per-rehydrate fee visible on billing. Support-initiated restores billed to internal cost until customer consents. Also count rehydrates against quota to discourage noise.

rachel: Failures: BF service down or corrupt -> fallback behavior?

zhen: Fallback to conservative path: return compact view + enqueue full scan job. Emit alert if BF error rate >0.1%. Implement rate-limiter to bound scans.

oliver: Edge: high FPR tenants will cause cost. Can we auto-increase BF bits or fall back to keeping full spans for that tenant?

anya: Auto-tune: if tenant's rehydrate-error-rate or rehydrate-cost/time exceeds threshold, we increase BF precision or flip tenant to extended-fidelity for a window.

zhen: Security: strip PII before compacting, encrypt shards at rest with region KMS, and restrict rehydrate API to approved roles.

rachel: Monitoring signals for pilot: bloom_fp_rate, rehydrate_rate, rehydrate_latency_p50/p95, percent_queries_satisfied_by_compact, cold_storage_gb_delta, support_restore_tickets. Add billing metric for rehydrate_cost/day.

anya: Pilot plan: infra/compact-archive-rehydrate-380123. Staging + 10% prod traffic for 2 weeks. Per-tenant opt-outs available. Success: >=25% cold tier storage reduction and <=15% increase in mean trace-search latency.

oliver: Add kill-switch + circuit breaker: if rehydrate_cost/hr > $X or p95 latency > 3x baseline or support tickets spike, disable archival.

zhen: I'll draft BF sizing and compact proto and share numbers. Also a simple broker pseudo-code:
```
if bf_service.exists(tenant_salt(request_id), request_hash):
  return {"mode":"rehydrating","eta":"10-30m"}
else:
  return {"mode":"compact","link":"/compact/<shard_id>"}
```

rachel: UX: show cost and ETA on rehydrate button, and a checkbox "priority (incident)" that requires justification.

anya: I'll make the experiment ticket + runbook, add monitors and dashboards. backup-bot, please create ticket and dashboard stubs.

backup-bot: Ticket created: infra/compact-archive-rehydrate-380123. Dashboards: obs.bloom.fp_rate, obs.rehydrate.latency, infra.storage.cold_compact_delta. Monitors attached.

anya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after 72h of telemetry.
